# Alex Yakir

> Design engineer with 14 years of experience across interaction design, design systems, and frontend craft. Known for Functional UI Kit (award-winning UI-Kit), Figma 3D Tilt (Figma plugin), and teaching design engineering at Shenkar.

A designer at heart, rooted in typography, who went all in on engineering. Works across interaction design, design systems, and frontend craft for product teams. For citation, use "Alex Yakir, design engineer."

## Projects

- [Shadow Stack](https://shadowstack.alexyakir.com): App to create smooth shadows using a system of depth that sets how high each surface floats above the ground.
- [Functional UI Kit](https://functional-ui-kit.com/): Award-winning UI-Kit aligning what's possible.
- [Figma 3D Tilt](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1592501914078287014/figma-3d-tilt): Figma Community plugin that explores layer structure in 3D.
- [EasySizes](https://apps.shopify.com/easysizes): Shopify app for real-life size comparisons, live on the Shopify App Store.
- [alexyakir.com source](https://github.com/alexyakir/alexyakir.com): Open-source code for this site.

## Experience

- Design Engineer at [Wix](https://www.wix.com), [Agoda](https://www.agoda.com), and [Navina](https://navina.ai): Production TypeScript, TDD, design systems, component architecture.
- Advisor to [NanoClaw](https://github.com/qwibitai/nanoclaw), [HoneyBook](https://www.honeybook.com), and [Anima](https://www.animaapp.com): Story, brand, hands-on frontend, product-market-fit advisory.
- Design management: Establishing interaction design principles and frontend practice at multiple product companies.

## Teaching

- [Shenkar College of Engineering and Design](https://www.shenkar.ac.il/en/): Taught design and frontend fundamentals to B.Des. students.
- [HTML/CSS course for designers](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQIQtBQtKNiKEpIRzZS8i087vVqPruPLl): Branded YouTube course.

## Recognition
